about.body: The S68 (BMW-sourced) is a V8 (hot-vee design), 4.4L (4,395 cc), Petrol MHEV engine used across Land Rover's 3 model range, in production 2023–present. We rebuild every S68 (BMW-sourced) to original specification, replacing worn timing components, bearings, gaskets and seals as standard.

byModel.body: The S68 (BMW-sourced) is fitted across Defender, Range Rover, Range Rover Sport — see the full applications table above for exact variants, generations and years.
